description: Retired-test ledger (SUITE-RECONCILIATION.md §2.2). Every test node deleted from the suite after the epoch reconciliation must be recorded here, keyed by its exact former node ID, with a disposition: 'dies_with_v5' (the invariant is v5/HMAC mechanics the epoch reset deletes), 'deleted_by: P1.4' (the subsystem is deleted outright), or 'coverage_owed: <work item>' (the invariant reappears in v6; coverage is owed there). tests/test_retired_tests_ledger.py enforces this against the committed pre-reconciliation inventory: a node cannot vanish without an entry.

entries.invariant: a jsonb payload key-reorder in the row is not drift/tamper (stored envelope is authoritative)
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation compares payload as canonical JCS bytes (V6-ENVELOPE §9.2) — key reorder is not a mismatch

entries.invariant: signature verification verifies the exact stored envelope bytes, with every signed field reconciled against the row
entries.carry_forward: v6 verification over stored canonical bytes (JCS fixed point, §5.4) + full row agreement (§9.1)

entries.invariant: transition events' signatures verify against the stored envelope (incl. entity_kind/hash_alg row fields)
entries.carry_forward: same as above, for workflow-transition events

entries.invariant: replay stays clean across key rotation (deprecated HMAC key present in keyset)
entries.carry_forward: replay verifies events across rotated keys under the v6 signed key lifecycle (P2.2); HMAC coexistence dies

entries.invariant: new events are signed with the active key's scheme, not a deprecated key's
entries.carry_forward: active-key selection under the v6 trust-log key lifecycle (P2.2)

entries.invariant: event N's prev link equals the predecessor's hash — asserted as sha256(envelope||signature), the v5 formula
entries.carry_forward: entity-chain link commits to the predecessor's v6 event_hash (domain-tagged formula, §5.3)

entries.invariant: a rewritten entity-chain row link is both a verification halt and a structural chain break
entries.carry_forward: v6: prev link is inside the signed envelope; row rewrite → reconciliation halt + chain break

entries.invariant: the public append API persists the entity-chain link — asserted via the v5 hash formula
entries.carry_forward: P1.7 writer persists v6 entity-chain links on append

entries.invariant: every event in a multi-event chain links to its predecessor — v5 formula asserted per link
entries.carry_forward: multi-event v6 entity chain integrity

entries.invariant: in-memory: prev link equals v5 sha256(envelope||signature)
entries.carry_forward: in-memory v6 entity-chain link (D2 parity suite)

entries.invariant: in-memory multi-event chain, v5 formula per link
entries.carry_forward: in-memory v6 entity chain (D2 parity suite)

entries.invariant: the hash chain is maintained even with no signing keys (keyless mode)
nulling canonical_envelope on a signed row halts replay (the row contradicts its own crypto material)
entries.carry_forward: envelope deletion on a v6 row is detected and halts (stored bytes are the artifact, §9.2)

entries.invariant: in-memory parity: envelope deletion halts
entries.carry_forward: in-memory v6 envelope-deletion detection (D2 parity suite)

entries.invariant: a rewritten project-chain row link is reported as a chain break by replay
entries.carry_forward: v6 project-chain tamper detection (link is signed; row rewrite reconciles INVALID)

entries.invariant: in-memory parity: corrupted project-chain link reports a chain break
entries.carry_forward: in-memory v6 project-chain tamper detection (D2 parity suite)

entries.invariant: one project-wide chain links events across work items; head pointer tracks the tail — asserted via v5 sha256(env||sig) and event_chain_head
entries.carry_forward: v6 previous_project_event_hash chain across entities + global-chain head sentinel

entries.invariant: the chain links by hash, immune to global_seq gaps — asserted via the v5 formula
entries.carry_forward: v6: order/completeness come only from hash links, never global_seq contiguity (§4.1)

entries.invariant: concurrent raw appends produce an unbroken project chain — verified by a local walk hardcoding the v5 hash formula
entries.carry_forward: concurrent v6 appends serialize onto one unbroken project chain

entries.invariant: with CACHE 1, global_seq order matches chain-link order — checked by a helper hardcoding the v5 formula
entries.carry_forward: global_seq allocation order consistent with v6 project-chain order (operational, CACHE 1)

entries.invariant: a forged project-chain row link halts verification and is reported as an orphan chain break
entries.carry_forward: v6 hash-walk orphan detection + signed-link reconciliation

entries.invariant: corrupting the genesis link leaves no root and every event is reported orphaned
entries.carry_forward: v6: genesis is a signed claim; a store with no reachable genesis fails verification loudly

entries.invariant: rewriting the transition row column fails verification with a named mismatch
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: transition (§9.2)

entries.invariant: rewriting the payload row column fails verification
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: payload as canonical JCS bytes

entries.invariant: rewriting actor_id fails verification
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: actor.principal_id ↔ actor_id

entries.invariant: rewriting actor_kind fails verification
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: actor.kind

entries.invariant: rewriting actor_metadata fails verification
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: actor.metadata (JCS bytes)

entries.invariant: rewriting workflow_name fails verification
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: workflow.name

entries.invariant: rewriting workflow_version fails verification
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: workflow.version

entries.invariant: rewriting key_id fails verification (key resolution uses the envelope value)
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: signing.key_id; resolution from envelope only

entries.invariant: rewriting hash_alg fails verification
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: chain.hash_algorithm

entries.invariant: a +1s timestamp rewrite fails verification
entries.carry_forward: v6 row reconciliation: occurred_at ↔ timestamp (instant equality)

entries.invariant: timezone re-rendering of the same instant is not tamper
entries.carry_forward: v6 timestamp comparison is instant-based, not text-based (§2.3/§9.2)

entries.invariant: jsonb key reorder of payload is not tamper
entries.carry_forward: v6 payload reconciliation via canonical JCS bytes

entries.invariant: global_seq rewrite is never a verification mismatch
entries.carry_forward: v6: global_seq is never compared and never authenticated (§4.1/§9.2)

entries.invariant: replay halts when a row transition was rewritten
entries.carry_forward: v6 replay halts on row/envelope disagreement

entries.invariant: replay halts when a row payload was rewritten
entries.carry_forward: v6 replay halts on payload mismatch

entries.invariant: repointing the unsigned work_item_id column away from entity_id fails verification (ENTITY_ALIAS_MISMATCH)
entries.carry_forward: v6 keeps work_item_id constrained == entity.id, unsigned (§7.3/§9.2)

entries.invariant: an unrecognizable stored envelope shape halts replay
entries.carry_forward: v6 strict parsing rejects unknown envelope shapes (§8) and replay halts

entries.invariant: nulling canonical_envelope on a signed row halts (row contradicts its own signature/hash)
entries.carry_forward: v6 envelope-deletion detection

entries.invariant: a legitimately envelopeless pre-002 row (v1-shape, re-signed) is UNVERIFIABLE — counted, not halted
in-memory parity: row rewrite halts replay
entries.carry_forward: in-memory v6 row-reconciliation halt (D2 parity suite)

entries.invariant: in-memory parity: envelope deletion halts
entries.carry_forward: in-memory v6 envelope-deletion detection (D2 parity suite)

entries.invariant: keyless in-memory events are UNVERIFIABLE / UNSIGNED_EVENT / KEYLESS_DUMMY and replay reports them
a clean exported bundle verifies offline with no findings
entries.carry_forward: clean v3 bundle verifies offline (statement signature model)

entries.invariant: a tampered event inside the bundle fails offline verification
entries.carry_forward: v3 offline tamper detection (membership root / chain / signature axes)

entries.invariant: a doctored bundle integrity binding is detected
entries.carry_forward: v3 statement signature replaces the unkeyed bundle_hash (the audit's 'unkeyed bundle hash' gap); doctored statements fail signature

entries.invariant: the bundle carries the registered principal public key (id, principal binding, scheme)
entries.carry_forward: v3 bundles carry key material as evidence (BUNDLE-V3 §4.3), verified against an external trust root

entries.invariant: offline verification verifies ed25519 signatures and counts HMAC events unverifiable in one bundle
entries.carry_forward: v3 offline event-signature verification (A-axes); the mixed HMAC population dies with the epoch

entries.invariant: a forged tail signature (invisible to chain checks) is caught by the signature check
entries.carry_forward: v3: forged event signature → axis A4 invalid; chain checks alone must not pass it

entries.invariant: an HMAC-only bundle is not 'verified': all signatures unverifiable, enforced_none_verified
a format-version downgrade to v1 cannot silently pass — skipped is reported and verified=False
entries.carry_forward: v3 verifier rejects non-v3 format_version outright (downgrade fails closed; BUNDLE-V3 §6)

entries.invariant: an asymmetric event whose key is absent from the bundle registry fails closed
entries.carry_forward: v3: missing key evidence → fail closed (A2/A5)

entries.invariant: actor↔signer binding mismatch fails closed
entries.carry_forward: v6 principal↔key binding verification (key_binding_event_hash / trust log) in bundle verification

entries.invariant: relabelling an event's scheme_id is a scheme_mismatch against the trusted key, not a verifier selector
entries.carry_forward: v6 signs scheme_id and requires equality with the trusted key's scheme (§3.1)

entries.invariant: export records an absent key registry; offline verification of asymmetric events then fails closed
entries.carry_forward: v3: absent key evidence recorded, never a silent pass

entries.invariant: export reports its own self-verification — asserted with HMAC-specific verified=False / signatures_verified==0
entries.carry_forward: v3 export self-verification report (a clean v6 store self-verifies True)

entries.invariant: an export whose written artifact fails self-verification raises (artifact kept for inspection)
entries.carry_forward: v3: write .partial → self-verify → replace only on success; failed self-verification must never publish to the destination

entries.invariant: store-level verification defects are reported in the export result, not fatal
entries.carry_forward: v3: unverifiable store defects reported; INVALID corpus refused at export (§9.1) — the reported/fatal boundary moves

entries.invariant: CLI export exit 0 means exported AND verifiable; an unverifiable store exits 3 (artifact still written)
entries.carry_forward: v3 CLI exit code driven by the self-verification applicability (BUNDLE-V3 §9.7)

entries.invariant: --allow-unverified opts an unverifiable export into exit 0
